sessionStart.bash: mkdir -p logs && echo "[TrexGame hook] sessionStart fired at $(date)" >> logs/agent-sessions.log
sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/agent-sessions.log -Value "[TrexGame hook] sessionStart fired at $(Get-Date)"

postToolUse.bash: mkdir -p logs && echo "[TrexGame hook] postToolUse fired at $(date)" >> logs/agent-sessions.log && npm run test:unit --silent
postToolUse.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/agent-sessions.log -Value "[TrexGame hook] postToolUse fired at $(Get-Date)"; npm run test:unit --silent

postToolUseFailure.bash: mkdir -p logs && echo "[TrexGame hook] postToolUseFailure fired at $(date)" >> logs/agent-sessions.log
postToolUseFailure.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/agent-sessions.log -Value "[TrexGame hook] postToolUseFailure fired at $(Get-Date)"
